text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next week is the long-awaited tryouts! For
newbie trainers like me, this event is our
first step on our journeys to bringing out
the best in
every racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the tryouts,
each runner does their best
to show off their abilities to prospective
trainers, who then scout them. It's an
important event for both parties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While there's still time between now and
then, my nerves—and excitement—are
getting the better of me. I decide to take
a stroll to
calm down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I walk through a park near the
academy, I hear the sound of children
playing. I turn towards the source of the
noise, only to see an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah! Time's up!
Looks like I win again!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Y-you're too fast, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
How're we s'posed to tag you when you're
the fastest runner?! You're
not playing
faaair!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Life isn't fair,
squirts! 'Sides, ya
wouldn't want me goin' easy
on ya just
'cause you're smaller than me, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Show us how fast you can run
again, and we'll forgive you!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I wanna see you go ZOOM!
Do it! Do it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What, again? Well,
if it'll make you happy,
I don't see why not. Back
it up, everybody!
Don't want any of ya gettin' hurt!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, ready,
kiddos? I'm only doin' this
once, so keep those
peepers peeled!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Uraaagh! Whaddaya think of dis?!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! That's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the speediest speedster ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those kids aren't kidding.
She's a powerful runner, but there's also
this playfulness to
it. And her acceleration! It's near 
instantaneous—almost like... like...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Did you just say—wait, who're you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly feel everyone's eyes on me. The
embarrassment sets in as I
realize I just
said that out loud.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for what? You wouldn't be
apologizin' if you didn't do anythin'
wrong.
And what're ya starin' at anyway? Get
behind me, kids!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before this misunderstanding gets out of
hand, I quickly stammer out
an
explanation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So you can't even take a walk without
daydreamin' about racin'?
Geez, you must
love your job a helluva lot.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Talk about coincidences though. You're a
rookie trainer, right? Well,
I'm workin'
towards my racin' debut myself.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Tamaaa! Hurry up! We wanna play hide
and seek next!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'll be right with ya! Phew...
Where do kids get all that
energy from?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the name's Tamamo Cross. Since
we're both rookies, I get
the feelin' we'll
be seein' a lotta each other.
See ya 'round!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross... Once she makes her
debut, how will her running
evolve? I leave
the park with something new to look
forward to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One week later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the tryouts is here. I scan the
crowd of runners preparing
to race, when I
catch sight of one I recognize...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's fine... You've got this in the bag...
Just
run as fast as you can... get
ahead of
everybody... and win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Losin' here isn't an option. Not now...
not
ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor seems completely different
from the day we met in the
park. I watch as
she takes her position...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Huff! I gotta win dis! I gotta! I gotta win no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is losing steam!
She's falling
behind the leading racers!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she slips back, so too does her chance
to place high in the race... Confusion
furrows my brow. What happened to the
runner I saw at the
park?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, huh? She showed a lot of
promise in the beginning of the race, but
she was way too hasty. She failed to
maintain the very
pace she set.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's clearly got the drive,
but with that teenie body, there's no
way she can
keep up with the competition in the final
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dammit... Dammit, dammit, dammit! The hell's wrong with me...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Tamamo Cross? You must be
exhausted after that run, but
do you have
a moment?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-yeah, sure...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I'll cut straight to the point—I want to
scout you. You might be rough around the
edges at the moment, but a bit of refining
will surely have
you shining in no time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Really. With me as your trainer, you might
make it to the graded
races. In fact, you
might even place in the top five. What do
you say?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddaya mean, "top five"? Give it to me
straight—you think I can
ace a G1 race or
not?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Well... I can't promise anything. If you
work hard, you might have a
chance, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Then get outta my face!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm lookin' to WIN! No ifs, ands, or buts about it! Top five's nowhere near good 'nuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But your punk ass thinks that's all I got?
Well, screw your stupid offer!
Take your
wishy-washy ways and find some other
chump!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. What an unruly racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other trainers stand by as Tamamo
Cross storms off, unimpressed by her
temper. But that same temper shows how
badly she wants to
win...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... dammit! What a low-down jerk!
Treatin' me like a loser...
but why wouldn't
he? That's how I ran today...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're... that trainer from the park...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're a rookie trainer, aren't ya? What
makes ya think a no-name
trainer like you
has what it takes?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya really think ya can take me on,
train me
up, and turn me into a
champ?! I'm not just
talkin' G1 here—I mean all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rage Tamamo Cross feels boils to the
surface, and she lashes out.
I desperately
search for words to quell the fire, but to
no avail.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Drop the act. You're nothing special, and
neither am I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross takes off, leaving me with
only my regret as company...
